Dear hotel management ! My name is Natalia Solodilova, I am the director of the travel agency “Sugar travel”. We are approached for help in booking rooms in your hotel. We have worked with you many times before, and all our clients have been satisfied with the level of service and comfort of their accommodation. I will soon be a guest at your hotel from August 30, 2024 to September 09, 2024. I highly appreciate the reputation of your hotel and would like to ask you to provide me with a good room to ensure a comfortable stay during my visit. I hope for your understanding and assistance in this matter. I would be grateful if you could fulfill my request. Thank you in advance for your attention and assistance.
-- Regards, Natalia Solodilova Travel agency “Sugar travel”
